ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var qf = vars.queryFields --- "select " ++ (vars.selectFieldNames as String default "Id") ++ " from " ++ (vars.sfEntityName default "") ++ " order by Id limit " ++ p('maxRecords')

logger.doc:name: LOG: Record Count
logger.message: *** Org Id: '#[vars.orgId]' - Page #[vars.pageNumber] - #[vars.entityName] FETCH RESULTS - SF Org Id: '#[vars.orgId]' - Record Count: '#[sizeOf(vars.sfResults default [])]' ***

validation:is-true.doc:name: Check if page is not empty

json-logger:logger.doc:name: LOG: Canonical Payload
json-logger:logger.message: #['SF Org Id: ' ++ vars.orgId default '' ++ ' - Canonical Payload']

anypoint-mq:publish.doc:name: Publish to Anypoint MQ
anypoint-mq:publish.anypoint-mq:properties: #[output application/java --- { SOURCE: 'SALESFORCE', ENTITY: vars.entityName, ENTITY_ID: vars.Id default '', BUSINESS_ID: vars.Id default '', ORG_ID: vars.orgId default '', OPERATION: 'SCHEDULED_FETCH' }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var qf = vars.queryFields --- "select " ++ (vars.selectFieldNames as String default "Id") ++ " from " ++ (vars.sfEntityName default "") ++ " where Id > '" ++ vars.vLastId default '0' ++ "' order by Id limit " ++ p('maxRecords')

logger.doc:name: LOG: Stop fetching results
logger.message: *** Org Id: '#[vars.orgId]' - #[vars.entityName] - Finished getting data from SF, stopping the loop ***
